name: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
description: Jimmy Carr hosts proceedings as the 8 Out of 10 Cats crew take over the words and numbers quiz.

videos.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown Mash-up
videos.overview: The Original Episode of 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown which was aired during Channel 4's Mash-Up Week

videos.title: The Rematch
videos.overview:
Jimmy Carr, Sean Lock and Jon Richardson take on the famous words and numbers quiz. Jimmy Carr hosts proceedings, and Sean Lock faces Jon Richardson in a rematch of the original encounter.

David O'Doherty is in Dictionary Corner along with Countdown regular Susie Dent. Meanwhile the country's favourite boffin Rachel Riley provides the letters and numbers with a little help from comedian Joe Wilkinson.
